title: Dragon and Blue Demon
description: A massive black dragon with glowing orange scales and green eyes coils through a stone archway on a European cobblestone street, its body wrapped around the broken masonry. A muscular blue demon with large horns stands in the archway holding a lantern, overlooking a narrow street lined with shops, awnings, and the distant dome of Sacré-Cœur under a dramatic twilight sky.
prompt: A colossal black dragon with glowing orange vein-like scales and piercing green eyes coils aggressively through a shattered stone archway on a narrow Parisian cobblestone street at dusk. A muscular blue demon with large curved horns stands beneath the arch holding a lit lantern. In the background, the illuminated dome of Sacré-Cœur rises above colorful shops with red and green awnings under a fiery purple and orange sky, dramatic fantasy style, cinematic lighting
